ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the diagram there are left and right estuary schematic diagrams. The question asks about the right diagram. Beside the right diagram are marked latitudes, with 33°50′ at the top and 33°33′ at the bottom, indicating that this region is in the Northern Hemisphere, and that the latitude at the top of the diagram is higher while the latitude at the bottom is lower. The arrows in the river channel of the right diagram indicate that the river water generally flows from the top of the diagram to the bottom, namely from north to south. The two sides of the small island at the estuary in the right diagram correspond respectively to labeled river banks, among which the bank on the right side of the diagram is labeled bank Ding. Then reason: In the Northern Hemisphere, affected by the geostrophic deflection force, moving objects deflect to the right. When river water flows from north to south, its right side corresponds to the west side/left side on the diagram, and the water flow deflects toward that side, causing stronger erosion; the opposite east side/right side has weaker water flow and is more prone to sediment deposition. The small island will continue to expand on the deposition side due to sediment, eventually connecting to the bank on the right side in the diagram. In the right diagram, this right-side deposition bank is labeled bank Ding, so the small island will eventually connect with bank Ding.

method.method_draft: 根据右图纬度先确定它在北半球，再根据箭头确定河水由北向南流。北半球南流河水向其右侧偏，即偏向图上的西侧/左侧，使该侧冲刷较强；相对的东侧/右侧为泥沙淤积侧。把图中该淤积侧对应的岸名读出为丁岸，因此小岛最终与丁岸相连。

再推理：北半球受地转偏向力影响，运动物体向右偏。河水由北向南流时，其右侧在图上对应西侧/左侧，水流偏向该侧，冲刷较强；相对的东侧/右侧水流较弱，更容易发生泥沙淤积。小岛会因泥沙继续在淤积侧扩展，最终向图中右侧的岸连接。右图中该右侧淤积岸标注为丁岸，所以小岛最终将与丁岸相连接。
